bullets.text: Risky VPN Surge - Users seek free VPNs amid Online Safety Act, risking data exposure to foreign servers.
UK Fibre Rollout Hits 80% - Full-fibre broadband coverage nears 80%, driven by Openreach's expansion efforts.
Full Fibre Adoption Surges - Despite a stagnant broadband market, full fibre connections grow significantly.
Open RAN 5G at Stadium - Boldyn Networks and VMO2 enhance 5G connectivity at Sunderland's Stadium of Light.
BT Expands AWS Partnership - New five-year deal with AWS aims to modernise BT's technology and customer experience.
RAN Market Recovery - Dell’Oro reports three consecutive quarters of RAN growth outside China.
Sustainability in Telecoms - Industry shifts focus to sustainability, balancing growth with environmental responsibility.
